title: Process for the polymerization of acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene resins
abstract: Acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS) resins are prepared by the mass or mass-suspension process employing a tertiary-butyl peroxy initiator having a 10-hour half-life between about 50° and 95° C. wherein initial polymerization of up to about 10 weight percent solids is conducted under plug flow conditions. From about 5 to 10 percent conversion to about 40 percent conversion is polymerized with agitation. The remaining polymerization is done with or without agitation. Improved impact resistance is obtained.
